bayts.text: And bear witness for me forever that I am well pleased with You and with him, possessed of an increase from You.
Increase me in knowledge, good pleasure and refinement, O You Who spared me misery and misfortune.
And drive Your enemies forever toward other than my harm: drive them all alike toward others than me.
And renew through me guidance, Your guidance, and busy Your enemies in a direction other than mine.
And reward with thanks my humble entreaty, O All-Hearing, O One toward Whom the multitudes tend.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have set me apart from what harms, and come between me and whoever harms,
without reunion, forever: so to You be my gratitude and my praise, proceeding with remembrance.
Bless and grant peace, O my God, on my behalf, upon my means of access, the path of favour.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me today to my proceeding toward what You love for me; increase my aims.
Increase me in turning toward You with good pleasure, o You Who spared me enemies and sickness.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that turns every harm toward others than me, with a peace that turns
what grieves me toward others than me, forever, upon him who has made my glad tidings perpetual.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bring out what grieves me, through You, from every heart, proceeding with Your drawing
for me and Your repelling toward others than me all that harms me, unto the Gardens, marked (by Your sign).
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have made me safe from the harm of the slinking Whisperer, of the jinn, of the enemies together, and of humankind (Qurʾān 114:4-6).
Bless with a blessing and a peace that are both complete, that encompass all joy and safety,
upon him who has already come, forever, between me and whoever drags toil upon me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make whoever wants my exhaustion despair of me, O You Who remove the one who wearies me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have fulfilled hope for me, O Generous, O You with Whom is all I long for.
Bless with a blessing and a peace that bear witness for me to triumph and remove misery
toward other than my creed, my word and deeds, and lead hope to me toward the Gardens,
upon him toward whom my ink tends, escorted by truthfulness and love.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my ink, above every water, a blessing like the rain of heaven.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing and a peace that repel what grieves me toward other than my person, that benefit
my whole being, in the open and in secret, that bestow on me the loftiest secret,
upon him toward whom my pens tend, with eulogy and blessing, together with my speech.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And efface through him the aim of idle talk from my writing, O You Who effaced my faults with remission.
You have effaced the aiming of idle talk at my writing, O You Who conveyed my love to the Prophet.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that raises what I have done to the Throne and the Footstool, O You Who raise,
upon him through whom You made my reflection clear for me, until I became among the enemies like an army,
with a peace that brings my intention to You and to him, generously, and it arrives.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today perfection of intellect, and increase through my intellect, forever, the people of transmitted knowledge.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have taken away what the Accursed slipped into it of his wiles, O Preventer Who repels him.
Bless with a blessing and a peace that banish him himself toward other than my person, and guide
my whole being toward You with good pleasure, without suffering and without aggression,
upon him toward whom my intentions tend; and deeds are only by intentions (ḥadīth).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And repel all that has made for my side, of the harm of the claw and the harm of the fang,
and the harm of the eye, of speech, and the harm of what has come or will come, and of evil and peril,
toward others than me and other than what was chosen for me, O You Who by Your grace lead good things to me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
